paite: Judah Kumpipa Ahaz akum sawm-le-nihna alal kum in Elah tapa Hoshea Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum kua alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Hoshea
english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, himahleh ama a Israel kumpipate bang zen in zaw ahih kei.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.

paite: Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in ava dou a, huchi in Hoshea asikha ahong hi a, siah apia hi.
english: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n, Aigupta kumpipa So kiang a mi sawl in Hoshea thuguk sawm ana theikhia a; a kumchin a, apiak zel bang in leng Assuria kumpipa kiang ah siah ape kei behlap lai a; huaiziak in Assuria kumpipa'n suangkul ah hensa in akhumta hi.
english: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n gam tengteng atuansuak vek a, Samaria ah ahohtou a, kum thum a-umkhum hi.
heading: Samaria Pukna
english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

paite: Hoshea kum kua alal kum in Assuria kumpipa'n Samaria ala a, Assuria gam ah Israelte api a, Halah, Habor a Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoih hi.
english: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

paite: Huchibang a, ana omna uh bel Israel suante'n Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh khut nuai a pan, Aigupta gam a pan a pikhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh tung a thil ahihkhelh ua, pathian dangte alau ziak uh ahi.
english: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a, ana delhkhiaksa namte thuzoh leh Israel kumpipate dan thusehte azuih zawk ziak uh leng ahi.
english: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA a Pathian uh tung ah thil hoih loutak aguk in ahih uhi. Akho teng uah galvil mite insang a pan kulh nei khopite pha in mun sangte abawl uhi.
english: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against Yahweh their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;

paite: Mual sang teng ah pathian limte leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in Asherah songte abawl uhi.
english: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree;

paite: Huai mun sang tengteng ah TOUPA'N ama ua adelhmangsa namte hih bang in gimlim ahal ua; TOUPA hehsak ding in thil gilou ahih lai uhi.
english: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom Yahweh carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke Yahweh to anger;

paite: TOUPA'N akiang uah, "Hichibang hih kei un," achih milimte nna leng asem uhi.
english: and they served idols, of which Yahweh had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”

paite: TOUPA'N, dan zuih ding na pi-le-pute uh ka piakleh ka sikha zawlneite zang a ka hon theihsak bang zel in, "Na omdan gilou uh lehngatsan unla, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zui un," chi in Israelte leh Judah zawlnei chih leh mu thei michih zang in atheisak hi.
english: Yet Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

paite: Huchi pipi in leng azui nuam kei ua, api-le-pute un TOUPA a Pathian uh gingta nuam lou a, angawng uh akhauhsak mah bang un, angawng uh akhauhsak uhi.
english: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in Yahweh their God.

paite: Adan thusehte, api-le-pute uh toh athukhun, akiang ua athu theihsakte anial ua; thil gina lou azui ua, bangmah lou phet ahong hita uh. Atungthu ua TOUPA'N, amau bang in zaw hih kei un, ana chihsa, akiang ua namte azui uhi.
english: They rejected his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom Yahweh had commanded them that they should not do like them.

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiak tengteng alehngatsan ua, bawngnou lim sun nih abawl ua, Asherah song abawl ua, van a om tengteng abia ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
english: They abandoned all the commandments of Yahweh their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.

paite: Atapate uh leh atanute uh mei tawn in alutsak ua, aisan leh bum aching ua, TOUPA hehna tokthou ding in amitmuh in thil hoih lou hih ding in akizuak uhi.
english: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Israelte tung ah heh petmah in aheh a, amuh phaklouhna ding ah asuanmang a; Judah nam kia lou ngal a-omta kei uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

paite: Judahte'n leng TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiakte azui kei ua, Israelte bawltawm dan thusehte azui zawta uhi.
english: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

paite: Israel suante himhim adeihta kei a, amau ahihgim a, amuh phak louh ua asuanmang masiah lok mite khut ah apia hi.
english: Yahweh rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.

paite: Israelte lah David inkote ahihna uh apaihsakta ngal a; huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam pen kumpipa ding in abawl ua; Jeroboam in Israelte'n TOUPA azuih uh ahawlkawi a, thil gilou thupi mahmah ahihsak hi.
english: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following Yahweh, and made them sin a great sin.

paite: Israel suante'n Jeroboam thilhihkhelh bangbang ahih sam ua;
english: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them

paite: TOUPA'N azawlnei tengteng zang a ana gensa bang a amuh phaklouhna a, asuanmang masiah huaite apaisan ngal kei ua. Huchi in Israelte amau gam a pan Assuria gam ah api ua, tuni tan in huai gam ah a-om lai uhi.
english: until Yahweh removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Babulon khomite, Kuth khomite, Ava khomite, Hamath khomite leh Sepharvaim khomite athukhak a, Samaria khote ah Israel suante mun aluahsak a; huchi in Samaria gam aluah ua, akhuate ah ateng uhi.
heading: Israel Ah Assuriate Ateng Uh
english: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.

paite: Huai lai a a-om tung un hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, huchi in TOUPA'N alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a, khenkhatte akeilum uhi.
english: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn’t fear Yahweh. Therefore Yahweh sent lions among them, which killed some of them.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, “Na lakkhiak a, Samaria gam khuate a na koih namte'n hiai gam Pathian omdan athei kei ua, huaiziak in, alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a; ngai dih, hiai gam Pathian omdan atheih louh ziak un athat uh," achi uhi.
english: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them; and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n, "Huai a sal a na pite uh lak a siampu khat pi unla, hong om sam henla, ama'n huai gam Pathian biakdan sinsak hen," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”

paite: Huchi in Samaria gam a pan apite uh lak a siampu khat Bethel ah ava teng a, TOUPA laudan ding asinsak hi.
english: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh nam chih in amau pathian chiat akibawl ua, Samari mite'n mun sang ana bawl innte ah nam chih in amau omna khua chiat ah huai apathiante chiat uh akoih uhi.
english: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.

paite: Babulon mite'n Sukkoth-benoth abawl ua, Kuthte'n Nergal abawl ua, Hamathte'n Ashima abawl ua;
english: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

paite: Ava mite'n Nibhaz leh Tartak abawl uhi. Sepharvaim mite'n pathiante Adrammelek leh Anammelek kiang ah atate ahal uhi.
english: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA laudan asiam ua, alak ua mineupente mun sang siampute in abawl ua, mun sang innte ah amau a ding in thil alan uhi.
english: So they feared Yahweh, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

paite: TOUPA alau ua, apikhiakna gam ua namte hihdan bang in amau pathiante nna asem uh.
english: They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.

paite: Tuma lam a, ahihdan bang un tuni tan in ahih lailai uhi. TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, TOUPA'N Jakob suan Israel achihte kiang ah,
english: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

paite: "pathian dangte zaw lau kei unla, amau be kei unla, akiang ah kithoih sam kei un.
english: with whom Yahweh had made a covenant and commanded them, saying, “You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them;

paite: TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupitak leh ban zak hial a Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa amah laudan na siam zawk ding uh ahi, amah na biak ding uh ahi a, ama kiang a na kithoih ding uh ahi.
english: but you shall fear Yahweh, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.

paite: Huchi in dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dante, thupiakte ahon na gelhsaksate tangtawn in na pom gige ding uh ahi; pathian dangte laudan na siam ding uh ahi kei.
english: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.

paite: Na kiang ua thu ka khun pen na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei; pathian dangte leng laudan na siam ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
english: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding uh ahi. Huchi in na melma tengteng khut a pan ama'n ahon hunkhe dia, chi a thu akhun a, amau a dia TOUPA thupiakte, dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dan bawlte, azui tuan kei uhi," achi hi.
english: But you shall fear Yahweh your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”

paite: Bangchi mah in leng azui nuam tuan kei ua, tuma lam a ahihdan bang un ahih lailai uhi.
english: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.

paite: Huchi in huai namte'n TOUPA alau ua; amilim bawltawmte uh nna leng asem lai uh. Huchi mah bang in asuante uh leh asuante uh suante tan in leng tuni tan in api-le-pute uh hih bang in ahih lailai uhi.
english: So these nations feared Yahweh, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.
